slides.texte_overlay:
Habits of men who never
lose their temper
They sleep enough. Tired men snap faster. A rested mind has much more patience for small annoyances. Protect your eight hours.
They walk away before they explode. "Give me ten minutes." Leaving for a moment is strength, not weakness. Come back calmer.
They talk about problems early. Small frustrations said calmly never grow into big angry moments. Say it early, say it kindly.
They train hard. Lifting, running, boxing. Physical effort burns off the tension that would otherwise come out as anger.
Before: small things made me angry. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and my mind feels calmer and more patient.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: small things made me angry. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My mind feels calmer and more patient.

slides.texte_overlay: They don't argue online. Comments, group chats, strangers. They know it's never worth their energy. Log off.
They ask questions before judging. "What happened?" Understanding the full story often removes the reason to be angry.
